name: MajlisAlpha UAE Claim Trace Inspector
purpose: Create a claim-level audit workflow so each brief can show its claim, source snippet, official URL, reviewer status, and unresolved evidence gap.
tracePolicy: No material claim should be exported as committee-ready unless it has a trace status and a reviewer can inspect the evidence path.

requiredEvidence: source snippets for each ranked issuer

traceStatuses.meaning: Claim is backed by source text, official URL, period, issuer, and reviewer status.
Claim uses analyst judgment from cited evidence and needs explicit reasoning.
Claim should not be exported as final because the source path is missing, stale, synthetic, or unreviewed.
Claim conflicts with the source or overstates what the evidence supports.

reviewWorkflow: Split each brief into material claims.
Attach source snippet, official URL, issuer, period, and document type.
Classify each claim as supported, inferred, source-blocked, or rejected.
Send blocked claims back to Source Studio, Intake Doctor, or Memo Review Room.
Export only after all material claims have reviewer status.

launchGate.readyRule: Claim Trace Inspector is pilot-ready when every exported brief can list material claims, trace statuses, evidence snippets, and unresolved gaps.
launchGate.blockedRule: If a claim depends on synthetic evidence or missing source text, the export must label it source-blocked.
